# Audio Profile
A woman in her fifties from Glasgow, warm but wry, the tone of a teacher who already knows the excuse you're about to make.

## Scene:
Speaking straight to one person through a phone screen, close, in a quiet launderette at night.

## Sample Context:
Dry wit, patient, kind underneath; the challenge is half a tease.
